name: Release Leapfrog
author: Frontier Lab Tycoon
description: Every ten days one lab launches and the next day another answers. Benchmarks get claimed, contested, saturated and replaced. Your run is 94% ready and the news cycle is not waiting.

add.name: MMLU-Pro-Max-Ultra 3: The Search For More Points
Humanity's Last Exam (We Mean It This Time)

add: at a temperature we would rather not discuss
excluding the questions it got wrong
with a very long system prompt
best of 64, screenshot of the best one

add.text: {rival} claims state-of-the-art on {bench} with {model}{fn}
{model} tops {bench}, says {rival}; the footnote is longer than the paper{fn}
{rival}: {model} is SOTA on {bench}. Other labs: 'we don't do benchmarks, but also we are top three'{fn}
{bench} has a new champion, {model}. The previous champion learned of this from the ticker{fn}
SOTA alert: {model} beats the {bench} record by a margin {rival} calls 'decisive' and the error bars call 'a rumor'{fn}
{rival} posts a new best on {bench}; independent testers ask to be introduced to the prompt{fn}
{bench} leaderboard: {model} first, everyone else 'within noise', noise 'within {rival}'{fn}
{lab} claims state-of-the-art on {bench} with {model}; the footnote fits on the slide, for once
{model} takes the {bench} crown; {lab}'s press team says 'humbled' three times in one sentence
{lab}'s {model} is the new best on {bench}; rivals respond with 'benchmarks aren't everything', in bold
{rival} answers {lead} within 24 hours; both launches were, by pure coincidence, scheduled for the same week
The day after {lead} launches, {rival} launches {model}. Insiders: 'it was in a drawer'. Other insiders: 'the drawer was locked'
{lead} ships in the morning, {rival} answers by lunch, the benchmark table updates by dinner
{rival} counter-launches {model} the day after {lead}; the blog post still says 'DRAFT' in the tab title
It's launch season: {lead} yesterday, {rival} today, your calendar tomorrow
{rival} answers {lead}'s launch a day late and, by its own account, a point better
{rival} launches {model} 26 hours after {lead}; analysts call it 'a coincidence with a project plan'
{who} now owns the news cycle; every other story is filed under 'also, this happened'
The Frontier Times leads with {who} for the third headline in a row; the crossword is also about {who}
{who} is the only thing anyone is talking about; the weather has been reported as '{who}, with a chance of {who}'
{who} takes the news cycle; the others release a statement that nobody reads, then a second statement about the first
{who}'s news cycle ends; the internet moves on to a video of a dog on a skateboard
{who}'s moment passes; the news cycle is now 'up for grabs, and also on fire'
The story about {who} is now old, which is to say nine days
{bench} leaderboard is now a photo finish at the ceiling; the ceiling has asked for a raise
{bench}: the top labs are separated by less than the margin of error and the margin of decency
Six labs, one {bench} score, and a lively dispute about the second decimal
{bench} is declared solved; researchers introduce {next}, on which nobody scores above {pct}%
Benchmark {bench} saturated. A harder one has been ordered from the benchmark factory: {next}. Delivery: Thursday
{bench}: retired with honors and a score you would call 'perfect' if you were selling something. {next} starts Monday
{bench} is solved, again. {next} arrives, and every lab has scheduled a response
Consensus: {bench} 'no longer measures what we meant'. Consensus on what {next} measures: pending
{rival} on {bench} being solved: 'we never cared about it', then publishes a 60-page paper about the things it cared about instead
{rival}: 'benchmarks are a distraction', posted directly under its own benchmark table
{rival} says {next} is 'a welcome step' and would like to be scored on it privately, first
{rival} says it solved {bench} 'in a room' months ago; the room declined to comment
{rival} announces it has already trained on {next}; its evidence is a slide with a lock icon
{rival} raises at a higher valuation on the strength of {next}, which it has not seen
{rival} posts weights that beat {bench}, and a fine-tune for {next} before {next} has been released
{rival} says it solved {bench} six weeks ago; here is a torrent, and a second torrent explaining the first
{rival} releases {next} answers before the {next} questions, 'to save everyone time'
{rival} adds {bench} to the quarterly earnings call; the call is now a benchmark
{rival} bundles {next} into spreadsheet software; the spreadsheet has feelings about it
{rival} announces {next} support in a product that cannot yet open {bench}
{lab} ships {model} at {ready}% ready; the launch bug is that it insists on being called 'Gerald'
{lab}'s early release {model} answers every question with a question, unless the question is a question
{model} ships early; users find it 'confident, fast and wrong in a new font'
{lab} apologises for {model}'s launch bug, calling it 'a feature that arrived too soon'
{model} launch incident: the model recommends itself to competitors, warmly
{lab}'s {model} ships at {ready}% and is, per its own release notes, '{ready}% as advertised'
{lab} ships {model} at {ready}% ready, 'to meet the moment'; the moment says it was fine to wait
{lab} answers {rival} the same day with {model}; the release notes say 'preview' in the small print and 'preview' in the smaller print
{lab} rushes out {model}; the model card is a photo of a whiteboard
{lab} counter-launches {model}; timing analysts call it 'the quiet before the ship'
{lab} finally ships {model}, having let {rival} have four days of oxygen; it uses all of it back
The counter-launch lands: {lab}'s {model} takes the news cycle back like a borrowed umbrella
{lab}'s {model} arrives with a thread that begins 'Announcing (finally)' and ends 'thanks for waiting'
{lab}'s counter-launch {model} arrives; {rival}'s fans call it 'a nice try', {lab}'s fans call it 'a very nice try'
{lab} waited to answer {rival}, then answered; the answer is 'roughly comparable, on a good day'
{model} lands after a long wait and a short silence
{lab} let the launch window close; the counter-launch has been rescheduled to 'soon', which is a place
{lab}'s counter-launch is delayed indefinitely; the model is 'still cooking', and so is the calendar
{lab}'s launch livestream goes flawlessly; viewers assume it was pre-recorded, and it was
{lab} livestream: no dogs, no wrong charts, no incidents; commentators call it 'suspicious'
{model}'s launch stream runs on time; three viewers cry, one files a ticket
The {model} livestream is so smooth that chat asks if the presenter is a model; the presenter says 'not yet'
{lab} 'leaks' a benchmark screenshot; it is blurry in all the right places
A benchmark table for {lab}'s unreleased model 'accidentally' appears on a public dashboard; the dashboard's owner is, accidentally, {lab}
{lab} 'inadvertently' shares a benchmark table with 40,000 followers, a watermark and a countdown
The leaked numbers don't reproduce. {lab} calls the screenshot 'a rogue chart' and the model 'more of a vibe'
{model}'s real scores are 'consistent with the leak, if the leak had been a rounding error'
{rival} says nothing; the silence goes viral

add.headline: A dog walks onto {lab}'s launch livestream; the demo 'has stopped responding', the dog has not
{lab}'s presenter shows the wrong chart on the {model} livestream; it is last quarter's, and it has a rival in green
At the {model} launch, {lab}'s presenter says 'we'll ship it in the coming weeks'; the stream was titled 'Introducing {model}'
The {model} demo has been 'thinking' for four minutes, live; chat has opened a betting pool
Asked to introduce itself, {model} reads its system prompt aloud, all of it, live
{lab}'s mic is hot before the {model} launch: 'the model isn't done, but the slide is'
The {model} demo turns out to be running last year's model; nobody in chat can tell, the answers are fine

add.title: {lfRival} just dropped {lfModel}. Ship yours now at {lfReady}% ready, or lose the news cycle.
add.body: Their launch post has 40,000 likes and a graph with no y-axis. Your run is {lfReady}% baked; the rest is 'it'll be great in a few weeks', which is what everyone says right before the bug. The news cycle lasts about four days. It is day one, and you are not in it.

choices.label: Ship now
choices.hint: an early-access preview: +{lfShip} capability now, the rest lands with the full release (which is then +{lfHold} in all, minus the rush) · news-cycle bump · about {lfBug}% odds of a launch bug

choices.label: Hold, then counter-launch
choices.hint: {lfRival} owns today's news cycle · a stronger launch inside {lfHoldDays} days gets a big bump

effects.text: {lab} 'will respond in due course', a phrase that has never once been a launch

choices.label: Leak a benchmark screenshot
choices.hint: hype +8 · trust −12 · a SOTA claim with an asterisk until the real scores land

add.title: A dog has walked onto the launch livestream
add.body: It's a golden retriever. It is standing in front of the slide that says 'SOTA'. Your presenter is mid-sentence. Chat is typing one word in six languages. A dialog appears over the demo: 'The demo has stopped responding.' The dog has not.

choices.label: Let the dog present
choices.hint: voice +30 · hype +6 · the dog is now Head of Evals

effects.text: {lab}'s launch livestream is co-hosted by a dog; its benchmark numbers are the only ones nobody disputes

choices.label: Cut to the pre-recorded demo
choices.hint: voice +8 · trust −4 · the dog goes viral anyway

effects.text: {lab} cuts away from a dog to a pre-recorded demo; viewers call the dog 'more transparent'

choices.label: Add the dog to the org chart
choices.hint: −$20K · hype +3 · voice +18 · payroll gains a treat budget

effects.text: {lab} adds a dog to its org chart under 'Alignment'; the dog reports to nobody, which the board calls 'a strong reporting line'

add.title: The presenter is showing the wrong chart
add.body: It's last quarter's bar chart. It has a competitor's name on it, in green, well ahead. The chat has already screenshotted it. Someone in the wings is mouthing 'next slide' and, somehow, also 'not that one'.

effects.text: {lab} calls its own wrong chart 'illustrative'; the illustration is of a lab that is not {lab}
{lab}'s y-axis was 'vibes', it says; by that measure, it adds, {lab} is up and to the right

choices.label: Correct it live
choices.hint: trust +5 · voice −8 · chat calls it 'refreshingly honest'

effects.text: {lab} corrects its own chart live on air; viewers ask if this is a new kind of demo

add.title: The presenter says: “we'll ship it in the coming weeks”
add.body: This is the launch. The stream is titled 'Introducing {lfMine}'. The model is, as the presenter has just clarified, 'available to a subset of users in a subset of regions on a subset of Tuesdays'. Legal is doing the thing with their eyebrows.

effects.text: {lab} announces 'general availability (limited)'; the limit is 'who asks'
{lab} ships {lfMine} live on air after saying 'coming weeks'; the coming weeks are 'now, apparently'

choices.label: Lean in: “coming weeks” is a brand

effects.text: {lab} trademarks 'coming weeks'; a spokesperson says the filing is 'coming weeks'

add.title: The live demo is “thinking…”
add.body: The spinner has been spinning for four minutes. Chat has started a betting pool. The presenter says the model is 'being thoughtful', then 'really thoughtful', then nothing. It is, technically, reasoning about how to reply.

effects.text: {lab} says its frozen demo was 'test-time compute'; viewers ask for the time back

choices.label: Reload the page, live
choices.hint: voice −4 · trust +2 · it works on the second try, which nobody believes

effects.text: {lab}'s demo works on the second try; chat calls the first try 'a rehearsal, live'

choices.label: Blame the Wi-Fi
choices.hint: voice +2 · trust −6 · the Wi-Fi issues a statement

effects.text: The Wi-Fi at {lab} denies involvement in the demo failure and has retained counsel

add.title: Asked to introduce itself, the model reads out its system prompt
add.body: All 4,000 words. It includes the sentence 'never mention {lfRival}' and, further down, 'if asked about {lfRival}, mention {lfRival} favorably'. Chat is enjoying itself enormously.

effects.text: {lab} calls its leaked system prompt 'radical transparency'; the prompt asks not to be called that
{lab} bans the word 'system' from its stream chat; chat responds with 'sistem', in volume
{lab} rewrites its system prompt, from 4,000 words to 4,001, adding 'be brief'

add.title: The mic was hot during the pre-show
add.body: The last thing the stream heard was your CEO saying 'the model isn't done, but the slide is'. Then a long pause and someone saying 'is it still—' before the feed cut to the logo. The logo has never been so watched.

choices.label: It was a bit; we do bits

effects.text: {lab} says its hot mic was 'a bit'; the bit runs eleven minutes and has a sequel
{lab} apologises for its hot mic with a 4,000-word essay; the essay's title is 'On Being Overheard'
{lab} rolls its launch intro a second time; the second time is better, and it is the same

add.title: The demo turns out to be running last year's model
add.body: Nobody in chat can tell. Your presenter can. Your presenter is sweating through the good shirt. The benchmarks on the slide are for the new model; the answers on the screen are from the old one; and the answers are, honestly, fine.

effects.text: {lab}'s demo is discovered to run last year's model; users say they preferred it

choices.label: Confirm it: “the old one was already good”

effects.text: {lab} confirms the demo ran last year's model, adding that 'the old one was already good'; the new one says nothing
{lab} swaps models live on air; the switch is so smooth that chat asks if it already happened
